# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [b5628eb9997b67cf6163a388f5aa06f321f3833a](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/b5628eb9997b67cf6163a388f5aa06f321f3833a).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree b494f799d4e7d954beb342f0a0522098475bf616).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
